title: A Surveyor's Notes
author: a surveyor
pages: Paced the old stone again for the baron. Nine strides round, and warm on the north face, where the sun never gets to it.
The big one's tracks are a yard long and easy to follow. I followed them backwards to see where it came from. They begin beside the stone. There are none leading up to it.
The dust on its shoulders is pale and very fine. It is not from any quarry I have worked, and I have worked them all.
I am told to write down which hills it walked out of. I have written the truth instead: I looked up, and then I stopped looking up.
